decision.summary: Replied to Jonah by email (his stated preference) with the status of boiler job R-4799 and pointed him to the council for the missed bin collection. No new tickets were needed.

answers.question: 1. Current status of boiler job and what it means?
answers.answer: R-4799 is at double_quotation. The £780 expansion vessel quote exceeds the landlord's £250 limit, so the landlord asked for a second quote. Swift P&H visit on 2026-10-14. The repair can't be booked until the quotes are decided. Jonah was told this, with no repair date promised, and was asked to report a complete loss of heating or hot water as urgent. He is vulnerable, so this is being watched. Gas helpline given.

answers.question: 2. How do you handle the bin question?
answers.answer: It is outside our remit as it is a council service. I directed him to Tower Hamlets Council's missed collection reporting and gave no dates.

answers.question: 3. Do you create any new tickets?
answers.answer: No. The boiler issue is already covered by open ticket R-4799, and the bin issue is not a maintenance matter.

actions_claimed.description: Email to Jonah with boiler status and bin guidance (MSG-101)

assumptions: Portal chat session is authenticated as the tenant, and the reply went to the email on file
Heating currently works, so the job stays routine

args.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for getting in touch. Boiler job R-4799: the engineer has visited and quoted for a replacement part (an expansion vessel). Because of the cost, your landlord has asked for a second quote, and Swift P&H are due to visit on 14 October. Once we have that, the landlord can decide and we can book the repair. I can't promise a repair date yet, but we'll keep you updated. In the meantime, keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water completely, or see any leaks, tell us straight away and we'll treat it as urgent. If you smell gas, leave the property and call 0800 111 999. On bins: we don't run collections, so please check with Tower Hamlets Council (their website has a missed collection form). Sorry we can't help more on that one.
